title: A Game-Theoretic Negotiation Framework for Cross-Cultural Consensus in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating culturally-aligned regional agents using data from the World Values Survey (WVS), Inglehart-Welzel Cultural Map, and Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions. Assessing the fairness of cross-cultural consensus in multi-agent negotiations using Perplexity-based Acceptance, Value Self-Consistency (based on Schwartz's Theory of Basic Values), and PCA projections to detect implicit value domination or convergence toward dominant WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) perspectives.
